notes: Fallback Applicant List invitation route only. The deployed Worker prefers MAKE_WEBHOOK_URL_INTERVIEW_PIPELINE, which points to helped-interview-calendar-sheet.blueprint.json and supports Calendar + Sheets creation and rescheduling. This shared scenario can create a Calendar event and send the applicant email for a new invitation, but it does not write a sheet row and cannot reschedule. Reconnect Google Calendar and Gmail after import.

Calendar modules receive scheduledAt as ISO 8601 text from the Worker. Map start with parseDate(1.scheduledAt; "YYYY-MM-DD[T]HH:mm:ss.SSSZ"; "UTC") and end with addMinutes(parseDate(1.scheduledAt; "YYYY-MM-DD[T]HH:mm:ss.SSSZ"; "UTC"); ifempty(1.durationMinutes; 30)). Do not use concat(); it is unavailable in the Make formula context used by this scenario. After import, run the webhook once to refresh its data structure and confirm scheduledAt and durationMinutes appear.
